core_coverage.answer_quote: Renekton is a close-range fighter/tank with an AD damage focus: his basic abilities deal physical damage and provide healing and a targeted stun, while Dominus adds nearby magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the role, damage types, healing and targeted stun. AD is supported as the externally typed broad learning orientation.

core_coverage.answer_quote: His attacks build Fury that empowers abilities. Slice is a damaging dash that unlocks a second dash only if it hits an enemy.
core_coverage.reason: Explains Fury empowerment and the enemy-hit requirement for the second dash.

citations.quote: Name: Renekton. Official role tags: Fighter, Tank.
Active: Renekton cleaves around himself, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
Active: Renekton's next basic attack within a few seconds will strike twice, dealing modified physical damage and briefly stunning the target.
During this time, Renekton creates an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Renekton is a close-range fighter/tank whose basic combat abilities deal physical damage, with healing and a targeted stun; Dominus adds nearby magic damage.

citations.quote: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.
Active - Slice: Renekton dashes in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through. If he hits an enemy, he can recast Slice and Dice within the next few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Fury strengthens his threats. Slice provides dash access, while access to its recast depends on hitting an enemy.
